changes.title: Lake hold
items: Over a lake you can't drop out of the treetops any more: pressing to come down there does nothing but a soft "nope", and you fly on at full speed

changes.title: Treehouse branches
items: The treehouse is rebuilt on the Ent's branches: round rooms with leafy roofs that open as you come in, joined by mossy branch walkways
The Terrace is open now, just the decks and the sky: walk off its front to fly
The map table has moved to the Atrium; two friends' bedrooms wait, locked, beside yours

changes.title: Music studio
items: New: the Music Studio (music-studio.html beside the game), for designing the game's synth sounds and hearing a MIDI file from Logic played on them through the game's own engine. The game's music is unchanged.
